roles.title: Applied AI Product Lead
roles.description: Lead the product strategy and delivery of customer-facing AI products. Define measurable outcomes, establish responsible-AI guardrails, align business and engineering teams, and take experiments from discovery through production readiness. Experience with conversational AI, agent workflows, and enterprise change is useful.

roles.title: Agent Platform Engineering Lead
roles.description: Guide a small engineering group building reliable agent infrastructure. Own tool integration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, human review, observability, and safe release practices. The role combines hands-on architecture with technical product decisions and cross-functional communication.
